ayahs.tr: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
ayahs.tl: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa

ayahs.tr: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
ayahs.tl: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda

ayahs.tr: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
ayahs.tl: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa

ayahs.tr: And He found you lost and guided [you],
ayahs.tl: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada

ayahs.tr: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
ayahs.tl: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar

ayahs.tr: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
ayahs.tl: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar

ayahs.tr: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
ayahs.tl: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith
